name: Henry Island

name_record.orig_narr: Was owned by Smith and was generally called "W.D. Smith's Island", which led to confusion, so locally it was called Port Head Outer Island. (MacKay).

scope: Search only: inverse guide and namepoint are not observations

name: Port Hood Island

name_record.orig_narr: Port Hood Island was approved in the 18th Report, 1924. Confirmed 7 July 1949 on 11K/3. Was formerly called Smith Island by the Admiralty, Interior Department, McKinlay's map and Lovell's gazetteer. (A. Martin)

scope: Search only: inverse guide and namepoint are not observations
